Subject: Invitation to Speak at [Conference Name]

Dear [Speaker Name],

I hope this email finds you well.

I am writing to you on behalf of [Organization/Conference Name] to invite you to be a keynote speaker at our upcoming conference, [Conference Name], taking place on [Date] in [Location/Virtual Platform].

This year’s conference theme is [Theme, e.g., "Innovating for a Sustainable Future"]. Given your extensive expertise and thought leadership in [Speaker's Field/Topic], we believe you would be an exceptional fit to inspire our audience. Your recent work on [Specific Project/Book/Article] particularly resonated with our planning committee, and we feel your insights would add tremendous value to our discussions.

We would be honored if you would consider joining us for a [Duration, e.g., 45-minute] keynote address, followed by a brief Q&A session.

Regarding the terms of our engagement, we are pleased to offer a speaking fee of [Amount]. Additionally, we will cover all travel and accommodation expenses for your trip, including [specific details like business class flights or hotel stay].

Please let us know if you are available and interested in this opportunity. We would be happy to schedule a brief call to discuss the details further and answer any questions you may have.

Thank you for considering our invitation. We look forward to the possibility of welcoming you as our keynote speaker.

Best regards,

[Your Name]
[Your Title]
[Organization Name]
[Phone Number]
[Email Address]
[Website URL]
